text.name: Crusader's Mace
text.description:
{Crusader's Mace}

All friendly creatures do +15% damage.
text.event: While your horse was peacefully nibbling grass, a man suddenly attacked you, trying to crush your head with the Crusader's Mace. Having quickly dealt with the villain, you took his weapon for yourself. Such a noble weapon should not be in the hands of scoundrels!
